cc:Work.dc:description: Conditional Pi_life map from a declared parent/unity sector to physical aperture world-lines; coexistence alone does not establish ownership or recall.

g.text: Static coexistence of world-lines does not establish common ownership, coupling, recall, or reincarnation. Those claims require an independently derived physical map and unity criterion.
